fact: General Notice 401 of 15 June 2026 states the Regulations on accreditation of security products and services, published under General Notice 953 of 17 December 2025, come into operation on commencement of section 20 and Part 5 of the Electronic Transactions Act, 2019.
title: General Notice No. 401: Commencement of Regulations regarding Accreditation of Security Products and Services and Providers of such Products and Services: Electronic Transaction Act, 2019
publisher: Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia (Government Gazette 8948)
